interaction_path.last_eligible: latest completed M5 candle with bar_close<=16:00_America/New_York
interaction_path.continuity: successive eligible bar opens differ by exactly 300 seconds

descriptive_measurement_definitions.first_outside_time: minimum eligible bar_open with location ABOVE or BELOW; NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_OUTSIDE otherwise
descriptive_measurement_definitions.first_outside_side: +1 for first ABOVE, -1 for first BELOW; NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_OUTSIDE otherwise
descriptive_measurement_definitions.outside_duration: maximum consecutive eligible outside_run bars, preserving side changes as continuous outside state
descriptive_measurement_definitions.in_zone_duration: count of eligible completed M5 candles located IN_ZONE
descriptive_measurement_definitions.above_duration: count of eligible completed M5 candles located ABOVE
descriptive_measurement_definitions.below_duration: count of eligible completed M5 candles located BELOW
descriptive_measurement_definitions.return_count: count of frozen grammar events FAILED_ABOVE, RETURNED_FROM_ABOVE, FAILED_BELOW, RETURNED_FROM_BELOW
descriptive_measurement_definitions.cross_through_count: count of frozen grammar events CROSS_ABOVE_TO_BELOW or CROSS_BELOW_TO_ABOVE
descriptive_measurement_definitions.terminal_location: location of final eligible completed M5 candle
descriptive_measurement_definitions.positive_excursion: max(close-first eligible close) over eligible path
descriptive_measurement_definitions.negative_excursion: min(close-first eligible close) over eligible path
descriptive_measurement_definitions.return_distance: terminal-direction peak excursion magnitude minus abs(signed_displacement); when terminal displacement=0 use max absolute excursion
descriptive_measurement_definitions.duration_seconds: last eligible bar close-first eligible bar open
descriptive_measurement_definitions.adjacent_delta: f(session,k+1)-f(session,k) for the same scalar f
descriptive_measurement_definitions.classification_survival: 1 when adjacent terminal_location values are equal, 0 when unequal
descriptive_measurement_definitions.contiguous_persistence: maximal contiguous k interval sharing the same terminal_location

WIDTH_DELTA_ADJACENT.eligibility_denominator: sessions with ELIGIBLE geometry at both k and k+1
WIDTH_DELTA_ADJACENT.availability_rules: exclude typed unavailable/censored geometry; retain counts
WIDTH_DELTA_ADJACENT.functional: arithmetic mean of eligible session values

FIRST_OUTSIDE_SIDE_BALANCE.eligibility_denominator: sessions with at least one eligible outside close
FIRST_OUTSIDE_SIDE_BALANCE.availability_rules: no outside close is NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_OUTSIDE and excluded from denominator
FIRST_OUTSIDE_SIDE_BALANCE.functional: arithmetic mean of eligible signed sides

LOCATION_BALANCE.eligibility_denominator: sessions with at least one eligible M5 candle
LOCATION_BALANCE.availability_rules: zero eligible candles is NOT_EVALUABLE and excluded
LOCATION_BALANCE.functional: arithmetic mean of eligible session balances

SIGNED_PATH_DISPLACEMENT.eligibility_denominator: sessions with at least two eligible M5 candles
SIGNED_PATH_DISPLACEMENT.availability_rules: shorter paths are NOT_EVALUABLE and excluded
SIGNED_PATH_DISPLACEMENT.functional: arithmetic mean of eligible session displacements

LEAVE_ONE_SUPPORTED_MONTH_OUT.construction: for each supported month, remove that month from the aggregate discovery population

CHRONOLOGICAL_BLOCK.construction: sort eligible sessions by civil_date then assign block=floor(4*zero_based_index/N)

status.TEMPORALLY_SUPPORTED: all required supported slice estimates are nonzero and share aggregate sign
status.TEMPORALLY_UNSTABLE: at least two required supported slices have nonzero sign opposite aggregate
status.TEMPORAL_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT: any required slice fails its typed support floor or has exactly zero estimate

formal_decision.raw_p: two-sided bootstrap tail probability with plus-one correction

rejection_transition_precedence.when: Holm passes and temporal status unstable
Holm passes and temporal status supported and template WIDTH_DELTA_ADJACENT
Holm passes and temporal status supported and other formal template

confirmation_emitter.decision: two-sided raw_p<=0.05 AND estimate sign equals frozen discovery sign
confirmation_emitter.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni alpha 0.05 across the frozen promoted-candidate registry

data_quality.m1_to_m5_parity_missing_underlying: PARITY_NOT_EVALUABLE when missing M1 is outside the authoritative 30-minute opening construction interval; not an observer coverage failure
